patterns.message: lib-imports-command: runtime/scripts/lib may not import a command. Use a function in runtime/scripts/lib, moving the shared one there first.
command-imports-command: a command may import another command only through the reviewed edges in .oxlintrc.json. Use a function in runtime/scripts/lib, moving the shared one there first.
